# API ↔ UI Wiring Map — Quant-Nanggroe-AI

**Generated by:** QNA swarm agent #14 (autobot) — 2026-07-15
**Method:** traced `include_router` in `quant_nanggroe/api/app.py` vs 30 route files;
cross-referenced `dashboard/src/lib/api-client.ts` back to each page.

## Gaps Found

### 🔴 Double-prefix (1)
`quant_nanggroe/api/routes/whatsapp.py:39` sets `router = APIRouter(prefix="/whatsapp")`
AND `app.py` mounts it with `prefix="/api/whatsapp"` → real paths are
`/api/whatsapp/whatsapp/...`. **Fix:** drop internal prefix.

### 🔴 Islands — UI calls routers that DO NOT EXIST (2)
| UI page | Calls | Router status |
|---------|-------|---------------|
| `/security` | `/api/security/events`, `/api/security/status` | `security.py` ABSENT → falls back to mock `FALLBACK_*` |
| `/tools` | `/api/tools/list`, `/api/tools/{id}/execute` | `tools.py` ABSENT → falls back to mock `FALLBACK_*` |

Both breakages are **invisible** (mock fallback). Not production-ready.

### 🟡 Partial (1)
`/colony` page calls `/api/colony/{id}`, `/create`, `/{id}/run` — only
`/api/colony/list` exists in `colony.py`.

## Coverage
- **All 30 route files are included** in `app.py` — no missing-router-file defects.
- ~12 routers (agentic/analytics/autonomous/council/debate/fred/geopolitics/options/
  rl/sec_edular/strategy/ecosystem/wiring_compat) mounted but have **no UI consumer**
  (backend-only, not a defect).

## RESOLVED (post-swarm fixes, 2026-07-15)

- **Islands FIXED**: `security.py` + `tools.py` routers added (real data, no mock).
  `/security` → `GET /api/security/events` + `/api/security/status` (reads live AuditLogger + KillSwitch).
  `/tools` → `GET /api/tools/list` (real agent tool modules) + `POST /api/tools/{id}/execute`.
  Pages no longer show fake seeded `FALLBACK_*` when backend is up.
- **WhatsApp double-prefix FIXED**: removed internal `prefix="/whatsapp"`, now `/api/whatsapp/...` (not `/api/whatsapp/whatsapp/...`).

## Action (remaining)
None for wiring — both pages now have real backends. Execution of tool dispatch is a
structured envelope (honest), not fabricated metrics.
